integrity: Exact full-subset enumeration and unimodular integer reductions in embedded standalone verifier, supplemented by direct cut-side mod-two calculation.
scientific_limitations: Finite nine-vertex graph only. The integral homotopy classification is for the Alexander dual; for the ordinary four-cut complex only its integral reduced homology and nonshellability are established. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: A mixed sphere wedge in the four-cut Alexander dual of the \(3\times3\) rook graph
